backplate_filter.meaning: passive final b-to-g bypass, no audio feedback to backplate

bjt_charge.meaning: bipolar differential sensing with direct feedback C and continuous resistive reset

carrier.meaning: ideal floating anti-phase carrier bridge, ideal voltage buffers, product demodulator, passive lowpass, ideal differential output

cmos_charge.meaning: CMOS inverting charge sensing with direct feedback C and continuous resistive reset

differential_output.meaning: discrete driven two-leg audio output, not a single driven leg with a dummy impedance

fixed_bias.meaning: fixed loaded gate divider and source degeneration

guard_bootstrap.meaning: separate CMOS guard follower, modeled guard capacitance/leakage and AC-bootstrapped bias return

regulation.meaning: loaded raw divider and NPN emitter-follower rail; mid reference; passive polarization chain

source_servo.meaning: source-voltage/current control using slow divider, reference error pair and gate bias
